ctx.bring-forward.note: ledger row ctx.bring-forward — WO control is the Layout tab objectOp button (index.html Layout.Object.BringForward); ctx-menu-on-image pre right-clicks the fixture img so selectedObject() falls back to lastObjectPick; applyObjectOp sets position:relative and zIndex 0->1

ctx.send-backward.note: ledger row ctx.send-backward — Layout tab objectOp send-backward decrements the picked img's zIndex 0->-1 (applyObjectOp z-order branch)

ctx.bring-to-foreground.note: ledger row ctx.bring-to-foreground — Layout tab objectOp bring-to-foreground sets zIndex to siblings' max+1 (single fixture img: 0+1); override reclassifies the unclassified census row so the contract runs

ctx.send-to-background.note: ledger row ctx.send-to-background — Layout tab objectOp send-to-background sets zIndex to siblings' min-1 (single fixture img: 0-1); census class 'dialog' was a ledger mislabel, reclassified as op

ctx.distribute-vertically.note: KNOWN GAP: ledger row ctx.distribute-vertically — distributeObjectsVertically needs selectedObjects.length >= 2 (shift-click multi-select); single-fixture-img pre leaves the handler no-oping — needs a multi-object pre (real runner vocabulary gap)

ctx.merge-shapes.note: KNOWN GAP: ledger row ctx.merge-shapes — census binds it to the Layout tab objectOp merge-union/intersect/subtract items, which sit in the hidden 'Merge shapes ▾' dropdown (ul.menu-list[hidden]) AND boolean shape merge needs >=2 selected shapes; double gap (dropdown-open pre + multi-object pre)

ctx.group.note: KNOWN GAP: ledger row ctx.group — Layout tab Group button is reachable (objectOp group -> groupSelectedObjects), but grouping requires >=2 img/div.object siblings in the parent; the single fixture img returns false and nothing mutates — needs a multi-object pre (real runner vocabulary gap)

ctx.ungroup.note: KNOWN GAP: ledger row ctx.ungroup — Layout tab Ungroup button is reachable, but ungroupSelectedObjects needs a selected .object-group (grouped-object state the runner cannot build: grouping itself already needs multi-select) — needs a grouped-object/multi-object pre (real runner vocabulary gap)
